reviews.title: Not bad but lacking the fine touches
reviews.text: Checkin was awesome, no queue at all but the ground staff were less than welcoming. Plane, on time but you board from T1 and take a bus all the way to the far end of T2. In flight announcements were unintelligible and they don't serve Qingdao beer, only soft drinks. Otherwise not bad for a Chinese airline.
reviews.author: MattwalesNorthWales
